qualification.en: The line defends and would expand the Affordable Care Act. It does not say whether most people should get coverage through a public plan run by the government or through private plans. It is shown and not scored.

quote: We’ll never quit fighting to protect and expand the Affordable Care Act, making quality care more accessible and affordable, as the Biden-Harris Administration has done.

sourceTitle.en: 2024 Democratic Party Platform (PDF, undated; text published by the DNC in its press release of August 18, 2024, for a delegate vote the next day), p. 19

summary.en: The platform says Democrats will protect and expand the Affordable Care Act and make care more accessible and affordable.
